proposed_by: revision of the v1 script: explicit releases, bimanual and close-object blocks, fixed attempt counts
changes_from_v1: every grasp block ends with an explicit release by placing, so release gets labels now even though only grasp is scored
a same-object bimanual block (both hands on one cup) and a close-objects block (cup and jar 10 cm apart), where cross-hand association should matter
attempt counts are fixed per block so opportunities per person are known in advance
duration 300 s; the 270-second v1 script stays the accepted default until a decision is recorded

blocks.instruction: Rest both hands flat on the table; check that both gloves, the green cup and the red marker fixed to the jar body (not the lid) remain in view.
Right hand: grasp the cup, hold 2 s, release by placing it back, return to rest. Three attempts. Then left hand: the same, three attempts.
Left hand holds the jar body; right hand reaches, grasps the cup, holds 2 s, releases by placing. Three attempts; rest between attempts while the left keeps holding.
Swap: right hand holds the jar body; left hand reaches, grasps the cup, holds 2 s, releases by placing. Three attempts.
Same object, both hands: grasp the cup together (one hand on the body, one on the handle), lift 5 cm, place, release both. Three attempts.
Close objects: cup and jar about 10 cm apart. Reach past the near object and grasp the far one, release; then grasp the near one, release. Right hand twice, left hand twice.
Contact without requesting a grasp: rest a hand on the cup 3 s without grasping; hover, hesitate and withdraw; include rest pauses. Two attempts per hand.
Both hands approach together, then one grasps and releases while the other makes an unrelated movement (adjusts a sleeve). Twice per side.
Brief natural hand crossing, 3-5 s of slow head turning with hands still, and one hand leaving and re-entering the view.
Finish at rest with both hands visible.
